name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional

fee.note: USD list price; taxes may apply. AWS charges set local-currency prices in countries that use the euro (€256), Australian dollar (A$449), Japanese yen (¥40,000), Korean won, Chinese yuan and Indian rupee (vouchers only), updated at least once a year. After you earn one AWS Certification, the next exam is 50% off.

exam.format: 75 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 180 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS recommends two or more years of experience using AWS services to design and implement cloud solutions.

scope: Designing optimized AWS solutions for complex organizations, based on the Well-Architected Framework: cloud-native, serverless and AI-integrated architectures across multiple accounts, security, compliance and governance, cost optimization, resilience and migration, and operational excellence.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Exam version change: SAP-C03 is in use from November 17, 2026 (registration opened October 27, 2026); the last day to take SAP-C02 was November 16, 2026. SAP-C02's four domains (26/29/25/20%) were reorganized into the five listed here, so older prep material follows a different outline.
